noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

retryable.description: Retry action if failure is a retryable c3 exception such as VersionConflict.

class.description: The class name of the native field type, parameter or return value (as marked with the "native" value type).

sourceVersion.description:
Specific version of the language required for the source code. The supported versions vary by language so for
languages that support multiple versions, this field is overridden with an enumeration. If unspecified, it is
assumed that the source code corresponds to a "base" version which is upward compatible.

title: Base of all scripting language marker annotations.
name: Ann.ImplLanguage
